newsitem.title: JAPAN: Suzutan Co Ltd ask-only on TV reports.
newsitem.headline: Suzutan Co Ltd ask-only on TV reports.

text.p: Shares in Suzutan Co Ltd were ask-only in early morning trade, after television reports said that Japan's securities watchdog had launched an investigation into the trading of shares in the retailer of women's clothing.
As of 0022 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 456 yen, after they were last traded at 466 yen on Friday.
Officials at the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) and Suzutan were not immediately available to comment on the report.
NHK said president Katsurao Suzui, then chairman of the company, sold one million shares of his company before the company announced a 6.6 billion yen loss in October 1994.

Following the loss announcement, shares in the company, which are listed on the first section of Tokyo Securities Exchange, plunged to around 900 yen from 1,300 yen, the public television network reported.
